changelog.8.1: Estimate transparency — right-click or double-click any live-estimate line to see exactly which objects and rules produced it (object, rule, condition, formula/recipe, qty). Rule overlap warning on save (flags duplicate/broader/narrower conditions). Fixed: structure extensions (DP/TP/4P/DTR) now appear in the estimate (iron + erection labour scaled per pole). New option to hide the length label on existing spans.
changelog.8.0: Windows installer with automatic updates — the app now ships as a Setup.exe (Start-menu shortcut + uninstaller) and checks GitHub for new versions on launch, downloading and installing them in one click. Removed the AI Rule Creator and its heavy dependency, roughly halving the install size (smaller, faster download; the rule editor's deterministic Smart Search is unchanged). Added a startup crash log for easier diagnosis.
changelog.7.9: Massive speed boost — live estimate refresh up to ~220x faster on large drawings (rule-engine evaluator + section caching, non-blocking debounced refresh, single-pass DB lookups). New service-drop cable sizes (4/6/25 SQMM); cable size editable on the service drop and kept in sync with the consumer; consumer phase now syncs to its service drop. DTR now defaults to 25KVA. PDF legend symbols redrawn to match the canvas exactly (wavy AB/PVC/service-drop lines, correct structure colours). Fixed structure/pole height showing 8m while counting 9m. Added Factory Reset (Settings menu). Extended validity until 30.07.2026.
changelog.7.6: Added Iron Recipes for granular control over iron calculations, live iron breakup along with the live estimate, minor adjustments, and rule updates.
changelog.7.5: AI Rule Creator (plain English rule generation), Service Identification Number (SIN) on existing poles, rule preservation on update, and extended app validity until June 30, 2026.
changelog.7.2: Fixed Excel/App total mismatch by rounding every item quantity to 3 decimals before amount calculation, matching Excel export precision and preventing hidden-decimal inflation of final totals.
changelog.6.9: Fixed openpyxl NameError on Excel export; all module imports verified clean
changelog.6.8: Custom canvas labels (EP1/PP1/HP1/DP1/DTR1/SC1) with configurable prefixes and sequential numbering; per-tab reset in Placement Defaults; auto-renumber on delete; dynamic PDF title strip height; filename trimmed to 6 words on save; project subject 300-char limit with live counter; faster startup (lazy openpyxl + exporters); Dead End Clamp rule fixed for existing poles; DTR new-span-as-existing bug fixed
changelog.6.7: Automated GitHub releases via Actions workflow; right-click property editing and numeric input dialogs
changelog.6.2: AB cable erection labour split by size (3CX50→LAB-37, 3CX70→LAB-36), dead-end threshold ≥65°, ACSR span wire-count tick marks, span labels show length only, label positioned perpendicularly at midpoint
changelog.6.1: Database Manager (add/edit/delete materials & labour), collapsible Placement Defaults dialog with scroll, existing-pole stay logic overhaul, IPC scoping to new AB cable spans, UH/MS-Flat conditional, stay angle tolerance configurable, stay direction bisects EX+NEW resultant
changelog.6.0: Initial production release — SmartPole, SmartStructure, SmartSpan, SmartConsumer, dynamic JSON rule engine, Excel iron breakup, PDF drawings with legend
